answer: The wander schedule is applied in meadow and thread exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4303 identities would post 2969 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
